_comment: Local smoke suite: tiny GTK3 windows under Xvfb with AT-SPI. Not a benchmark; it proves the harness end to end. `plan` is read only by the scripted stub model; `check` is the checker (keys must equal the app's state.json).

tasks.instruction: In the 'Dove Bench – rename' window, set the Name field to "Ada Lovelace" and press Save.
In the 'Dove Bench – prefs' window, turn on 'Enable notifications', choose the Dark theme and press Apply.
In the 'Dove Bench – counter' window, press Increment until the count is exactly 3.
In the 'Dove Bench – signup' window, fill First name "Grace", Last name "Hopper" and Email "grace@example.com", then press Submit.
